messages:
Maya: Heads up y'all, there's a stupidly late game on Friday (11:30pm). Anyone want to do a 'midnight watch + food bet'?
Jordan: I'm down if we can convince facilities to keep Conf A unlocked.
Lee: I will hold the floor. Also bets: burger vs tacos? I'm team tacos.
Ava: Burgers forever. I'll fight you for it. :smirk:
Maya: Proposal: winner gets bragging rights + loser supplies lunch Monday (burgers or tacos accordingly). $3 venmo side if you want extra motivation.
Jordan: low stakes = high drama. count me in.
Lee: Also quick fantasy update: my QB blew a 20-point lead and I'm now praying to the waiver wire.
Ava: lol Lee. I need a miracle or a very lucky kicker.
Maya: Logistics: projector available in Conf A, I'll bring HDMI adapter. Start at 11:25 to grab the good seats?
Jordan: I'll swing by with a portable lamp if you want ambient lighting.
Ava: I'll bring a deck of silly sports trading cards for halftime entertainment.
Maya: Food call — emoji vote: :hamburger: for burgers, :taco: for tacos.
Lee: :taco:
Jordan: :taco:
Ava: :hamburger: but will still eat tacos if I lose.
Maya: Okay tacos majority. Lee, you're on taco procurement hero duty?
Lee: I can do a taco order for ~12 people. need someone to Venmo me.
Jordan: I'll Venmo. DM me details.
Ava: Also can we get some non-alc drinks? I'll bring sparkling water.
Maya: snackbot, do we have paper plates and napkins?
snackbot: Inventory: paper plates (25), napkins (40), cups (30), plastic cutlery (0). Suggest bringing extra forks.
Maya: Noted, I'll grab disposable forks.
Jordan: Anyone want to put a tiny consolation prize: loser wears a goofy hat on Monday?
Ava: Yes. Must be ridiculous. I nominate the inflatable crown from storage.
Lee: Agreed. I will *not* look good in an inflatable crown. Stakes are real.
Maya: OK final checklist: Conf A 11:20pm, projector, tacos ordered by 10pm, Venmo for Lee, inflatable crown on standby. See you late-night heroes. :crescent_moon:
Jordan: See you. coffee will be flowing Monday either way.
Ava: If I lose I'm claiming the crown victory photo for Slack.
Lee: Can't wait.
